items.script: My name is Soren. The dam has ended the flooding that used to destroy the lower villages every few years, and it has also stopped the silt that made their fields worth farming. items.script: I am Felipe. Two men who were present at the same meeting in nineteen sixty eight have given me accounts that cannot both be true, and both of them are certain. Neither is lying in any sense I can detect. Memory is reconstructive, and forty years of telling a story is forty years of rehearsing a version. My job is not to decide which one is right; it is to record both and mark clearly where they diverge.

items.script: I am Felipe. Two men who were present at the same meeting in nineteen sixty eight have given me accounts that cannot both be true, and both of them are certain. Neither is lying in any sense I can detect. Memory is reconstructive, and forty years of telling a story is forty years of rehearsing a version. items.script: My name is Kelsang. These manuscripts are liturgical objects that the community reads aloud on particular days, and every reading costs the folios a measurable amount. Perfect conservation means the community loses the practice that gave the objects their meaning, and unrestricted use means that in two centuries there is nothing to conserve. items.script: My name is Sigrun. Three manuscripts give three versions of this passage, and the nineteenth century editors produced a fourth by choosing the best line from each. items.script: My name is Ulla. Our reference corpus is built from published prose, broadcast transcripts and parliamentary records, which is a defensible sample and is also overwhelmingly the language of people who were educated in a particular way. When a construction from another variety appears, our tools mark it as rare, and rare in our corpus becomes non standard in the grammar written from it, and non standard becomes an error in the classroom two steps later. Nobody in that chain did anything careless. The judgment was made when the sample was drawn, and everything after that was arithmetic.

items.script: I am Vittorio. The aria we all consider the emotional center of the second act was cut by the composer after three performances and restored by a conductor in nineteen twenty two, and audiences have known the opera in that form for a century. Arguing for the composer's version means arguing that a hundred years of performance history counts for nothing, which is a strange position for anybody who believes opera is a living practice. Arguing for the restored version means the composer's own judgment is the one voice we ignore.

items.script: My name is Wanjiru. We report cost per beneficiary because donors can compare it across programs, and the programs that score best are the ones that hand out identical items to large groups quickly. The program I am proudest of gave forty families a small budget and a conversation about what they needed. Its cost per beneficiary is terrible. I have stopped trying to argue the number down and started asking donors what they think the number is for, which is a slower conversation and the only one worth having.

items.script: My name is Yusra. Decision makers are trained to weigh internal consistency, and a person who gives the same account four times in the same order is believed. items.script: Our new translation is clearer, and a congregation that has said the older words for fifty years does not experience clarity as a gain.

items.script: My name is Anselm. Our new translation is clearer, and a congregation that has said the older words for fifty years does not experience clarity as a gain. They know the old text by heart, which means they can pray it while thinking about something else, and that absent minded fluency is not a defect of religious language but very close to its purpose. Comprehension and familiarity are both real goods. I voted for the clearer text and I would not tell anybody they are wrong to grieve.

items.script: I am Beatrix. The claim as drafted covers any system that performs this function by any means, and the applicant has built one implementation. Granting it hands them everything in a space they have explored a corner of. Narrowing it to what they actually built rewards the disclosure and leaves obvious variations free, and it also means a competitor changes one component and takes the market from the party that did the work. Neither outcome is just, and the office has to choose one this afternoon.

items.script: I am Dagny. Our table prices this cover accurately, and pricing it accurately means the households most likely to claim pay the most, which is the same as saying that the people who most need the cover can least afford it. Insurance is not a moral instrument and I am not asking it to be one. I do want the people who quote our numbers in policy debates to notice that an actuarially fair price and an accessible one are different objects, and that choosing between them is not an actuarial question.

items.script: My name is Marisol. The transcript shows the interpreted English and marks the original testimony as spoken in another language, without recording what was said. On appeal the court reviews the transcript, which means it reviews my work rather than the witness's words, and any error I made has become the fact of the case. I have asked for the source audio to be retained. The objection is storage cost, and I notice that the cost is borne by an institution and the risk by a person.

items.script: I am Nuala. The original decision was made by a system in milliseconds and a human review in about eight seconds, and my appeal review takes twenty minutes because I read the thread that the post was answering. About a third of the removals I look at are correct in isolation and wrong in context. The appeal process is the only stage that has any context at all, and it exists as an exception, which means the system is designed so that the only accurate stage is the one almost nobody reaches.
